item.title: Head-to-tail assembled borphyrins for solid-state lithium extraction

Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Borphyrin introduces a dioxaborole-linked, head-to-tail macrocycle with a rigid 16-crown-4-like cavity, enabling strong Li⁺ affinity and high selectivity over competing cations in dry solid-liquid extraction. It uniquely extracts lithium from crystalline ether-insoluble salts and dried mixed-salt matrices, establishing a new molecular platform for selective lithium recognition and solid-state extraction.
